conditions.runtime: FTB Quests 2001.4.22 is installed and a real server player logs in.

change.summary: Keep the universal authored quest book available by reconciling the native FTB team lock after ServerLogin admission.

modifiers.before: A persisted or newly resolved native team may retain locked=true and make every entry report Quests locked!.
modifiers.after: The optional adapter waits for FTB Teams and ServerLogin authentication, clears the native lock, saves only changed data and re-sends the native quest definitions. FTB installs its ClientQuestFile and issues its own TeamData request in the correct order. Reloads unlock authoritative team data before definitions are sent. Native progress, rewards and claims remain authoritative.

rationale.purpose: Make the requested unlocked quest state durable without replacing FTB Quests or rewriting progression.
rationale.decision_source: User reported that quests stay locked on MineRENT and a local dedicated server while the integrated singleplayer server remains available. The installed FTB Quests bytecode and JEM 5.2.4 versus 5.3.0 artifact comparison identified the missing native team reconciliation.

introduced.summary: Clear and save only a changed native FTB team lock when its player logs in.

history.summary: Replace one-time command recovery with an idempotent native login reconciliation.
Move reconciliation from the earlier Forge player-login event to FTB Teams' resolved login/team-change boundary and synchronize the result on the following server tick.

Remove unsolicited full TeamData messages at login and definition reload, which could decode against a null or obsolete client quest file. Retain native lock messages and the post-definition client request.
Restore the established native team unlock lifecycle after Major Update 4 branched before the 5.2.4 correction.
Load JEM Advancements 5.3.1 with 591 quests on the ordinary local server and install the exact native AutoModpack publication in the closed test jem profile.
Repeat the idempotent unlock inside FTB's post-definition request before its native full TeamData response, including when the persisted flag was already false and no delta packet was emitted.
Wait for ServerLogin authentication, then resend native quest definitions so FTB requests the unlocked TeamData snapshot only after its client quest file exists.

relations: FTB Teams resolved login -> ServerLogin admission -> native quest definitions -> native TeamData request -> unlocked quest presentation
notes: The local dedicated-server QA session opened the FTB quest map and a concrete quest after authentication without a locked message.
unresolved: MineRENT player acceptance remains pending after deployment.
